name: QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 (Pioneer UV)
description: The QiYi M Pro 3x3 V3 is a new entry-level 3x3 from QiYi. It is more flexible than most cubes in its class, making it feel more like a simplified version of a higher-end cube than other budget cubes. This version has a magnetic core and UV coating for enhanced stability and grip.
